resolution.question: Will the retiring owner of Fenwick & Sloane name which of her two deputies will take over as general manager before holiday trading starts on November 1?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-11-01T09:00:00+00:00, the persistent event history shows that the owner has publicly named which deputy will take over as general manager (e.g., an announcement to staff, a written notice, or a direct communication to both deputies). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
